decisionRule: Each capability has exactly one classification, based on inspected implementation and the existing Supabase contract, not filenames.

evidence.behavior: Unity application bootstrap and service composition.
Unity runtime presentation bootstrap.
Android application identity is configured for Unity.

capabilities.decision: Keep Unity as the sole Android runtime; Expo is a migration reference, not an additional runtime.

evidence.behavior: Expo repository exposes email sign-in, email sign-up, and sign-out; no reset or provider flow was found.
Expo observes session state and persists tutorial/quality preferences.
Unity implements email sign-in/sign-up, confirmation-required handling, refresh/restore, and remote sign-out with local cleanup.
Unity exposes generic player-facing auth feedback and an explicit email-confirmation state.
Unity refreshes the player snapshot after restoring a persisted session.
Unity provides sign-in and account-creation actions.
Unity code uses Android Keystore-backed AES/GCM session storage; device behavior is unverified.

capabilities.decision: Port only supported email auth/session behavior; the live project requires email confirmation and has no external provider enabled. Keep credentials in secure storage and verify on Android before declaring parity.

evidence.behavior: Expo persists quality and tutorial progress locally and tracks auth readiness.
Unity loads profile, progress, and player insight state through the existing store.
Unity reads player statistics and rank through the same existing read-only RPC contracts used by Expo.
Unity persists reduced-motion preference and last route.

capabilities.decision: Match useful player-state reads while keeping persistent player progress and competitive rank authoritative in Supabase; keep device-local presentation preferences separate.

evidence.behavior: Expo reads the active card catalogue, player collection, and card detail data.
Unity exposes catalogue/collection reads.
Unity renders a virtualized card gallery.

capabilities.decision: Port collection filters, inspection, and useful empty/error states without replacing canonical card data or artwork.

evidence.behavior: Expo validates and saves decks and stores match formations through RPCs.
Unity uses the existing deck/formation backend contracts.

capabilities.decision: Reuse current Supabase contracts; port the interaction flow only, and do not duplicate validation authority.

evidence.behavior: Expo resolves PvP through vexforge_battle_resolve and validates the result.
Unity resolves PvP through the existing backend call.
Unity consumes returned events for presentation.

capabilities.decision: Supabase remains the only competitive resolver and settlement authority; never port the local Expo tactical lab into competitive play.

evidence.behavior: Expo classifies event types into presentation categories.
Expo constructs replay frames from authoritative result events.
Unity sequences the event presentation; replay controls/parity remain unverified.

capabilities.decision: Port event semantics, pacing, replay controls, and skip behavior without porting battle rules.

evidence.behavior: Expo buys/opens packs through RPCs and validates server-returned opened cards.
Expo defines staged, interactive reveal cues with audio and haptic intent.
Unity currently displays a timed vault/relic sequence without card-by-card interaction.

capabilities.decision: Connect the Unity ceremony to the authoritative order/open result, then port interaction and reveal semantics.

evidence.behavior: Expo exposes world/boss/raid surfaces backed by repository data.
Expo provides a tutorial route and persisted tutorial progression.
Unity tutorial is integrated with the authorized battle gate.
Unity presents structural boss arrival/event cues.

capabilities.decision: Port supported navigation and tutorial semantics; keep boss damage and rewards server-authoritative.

evidence.behavior: Expo maps presentation categories to runtime audio cues.
Unity maps a subset of battle event types to locally loaded clips.

capabilities.decision: Port cue taxonomy and user settings where source behavior exists; audio must remain optional and never affect rules.

evidence.behavior: Expo exposes selection, impact, success, and warning haptics.
Pack timeline stages declare semantic haptic cues.

capabilities.decision: Implement a native Unity haptic service only for the existing semantic cues; fail safely when unsupported.

evidence.behavior: Expo rendering checks reduced-motion preference.
Unity persists a reduced-motion preference.
Unity selects presentation quality budgets.

capabilities.decision: Connect reduced-motion state to Unity animation/camera/VFX and preserve the rule that quality changes presentation only.

evidence.behavior: Expo wallet, shop, market, fusion, withdrawal, and reward mutations use Supabase RPCs.
Unity consumes existing player/economy contracts.

capabilities.decision: Port only UI flows with current backend contracts; keep prices, eligibility, balances, and settlement authoritative server-side.

evidence.behavior: Expo calls current friend, private/global chat, clan, and presence RPCs.
Unity contains a social repository boundary.
Unity contains a social UI surface.

capabilities.decision: Compare each screen/action to its live contract and port only supported behavior.

evidence.behavior: No Expo analytics/telemetry integration was found in the inspected runtime source.

capabilities.decision: Do not invent telemetry events or backend contracts. Revisit only if an existing source contract is found.

evidence.behavior: Current boss arrival can use a structural primitive presentation.
Foundation uses a resource manifest; separable identity art needs an asset-level audit.

capabilities.decision: Do not substitute generated art; verify official/separable boss art and manifest provenance before closing this gap.

evidence.behavior: Existing web portal is frozen and is not an Android game runtime.
Separate Kivora product and migrations.

capabilities.decision: Preserve unchanged and outside VEXFORGE runtime migration scope.

evidence.behavior: Editor, device, parity, security, and deletion verification remain required.

capabilities.decision: Keep mobile/** until every removal gate is satisfied with evidence.
